mapper.select: SELECT employees.id AS employeeId, employees.name_en AS employeeNameEn, employees.name_kh AS employeeNameKh FROM employee_attendances LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = employee_attendances.employee_id LEFT JOIN employee_department_histories ON employee_department_histories.department_id = #{filter.departmentId} WHERE employees.is_active = 1 AND MONTH(employee_attendances.datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) GROUP BY employees.id, employees.name_en
SELECT day_rate FROM employees WHERE id = #{employeeId}
SELECT night_rate FROM employees WHERE id = #{employeeId}
SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE DATE(pay_date) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{filter.date}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND #{filter.date};

SELECT SUM(total_working_minute) FROM employee_attendances WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND MONTH(datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND day IN ('Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday');

SELECT SUM(total_working_minute) FROM employee_attendances WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND MONTH(datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND day IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday');

SELECT SUM(ea.total_working_minute) FROM employee_attendances ea LEFT JOIN employee_work_shifts ews ON ews.work_shift_id = ea.work_shift_id AND ews.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND ews.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN work_shifts ws ON ws.id = ews.work_shift_id AND ws.is_active = 1 WHERE ws.id = 3 AND ea.is_active = 1 AND ea.employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND MONTH(ea.datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{filter.date});
